bac4ac37a19310357baff3620e535c491a79b4fa.summary: A threat actor naming index published by Microsoft's threat intelligence team. It maps many tracked actor names to their listed origin or threat category and to alternative names used by other vendors. It is a lookup list of actors rather than a threat report about any specific campaign, incident, malware or vulnerability.

ba1dea5cff18fff646a1a4e7aa1344b8fe869fa1.summary: A DataBreaches article (published 2025-08-03, updated 2025-08-13) asks whether Scattered Spider and ShinyHunters are one group. It cites Google Threat Intelligence Group clusters UNC6040, UNC6240 and UNC3944, and Abrams' view that they overlap. It reports voice-phishing attacks on Salesforce instances and later data-theft extortion, including a PowerSchool payment of almost $3 million and a 4 BTC payment linked to LVMH. A Telegram account claimed both groups are the same, but the author says this cannot be confirmed. The article also questions whether France arrested the ShinyHunters leader.
